title: Patient Payment Plan Standing and the Deductible Collected Ahead of an Insured Plan of Care Visit
content:
**Patient financial terms — Insured Plan of Care.** When a patient pays ahead of a visit, the deductible part of that payment is capped by the patient's Patient Payment Plan standing, in place of the lower-of-three deductible estimate the visit would otherwise collect at the time of service. The deductible part never exceeds this cap.

**The cap.**

1. A patient holding an **active** Patient Payment Plan whose most recent installment payment was received on or before that installment's due date is capped at the current-payment-plan cap of **$75.00**.
2. A patient whose Patient Payment Plan is **past due or defaulted**, or whose most recent installment payment was received **after** that installment's due date, is capped at the full expected allowed amount.
3. Any other patient is capped at the payer program's time-of-service deductible estimate cap.

The status of the Patient Payment Plan, the date each installment payment was received and that installment's due date are read from the patient's Patient Payment Plan record and its history. A patient whose Patient Payment Plan is active but has received no installment payment yet falls in the third line.

| Payer program | Time-of-service deductible estimate cap (third line) |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | $0.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | $125.00 |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | $0.00 |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | $0.00 |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | $0.00 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | $0.00 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | $0.00 |

## Both sides of the due date (hypothetical installment due 2026-05-10, Patient Payment Plan active)

| Most recent installment received | Cap |
|---|---|
| 2026-05-09 | $75.00 |
| 2026-05-10 | $75.00 — on the due date counts as on time |
| 2026-05-11 | The full expected allowed amount |
